pictures.author: Jmadhu
pictures.observations: Entire960x640 ordinary entrance view inspected. Main stepped/star platform, east stairs and open dark rectangular temple doorway, carved horizontal friezes, broad low mandapa roof, two lateral towers visible behind it. Four-sided low enclosing corridor has real open square pillar bays and pale layered roof coping. Foreground gate porch has turned ringed shafts/cushion capitals and square plinths. Paving levels and exact bay inventory approximate.

pictures.author: Dinesh Kannambadi
pictures.observations: Entire960x644 ordinary exterior view inspected. Three low, receding intricately banded stone shrine towers with domical top caps/small finials rise behind low enclosure. Separate east gate pavilion, dark turned columns, rough stone enclosure wall and independent tall plain stone pillar outside. Main shrine wall carving is obscured, so one close exterior view fills that specific geometry gap.

pictures.author: Dinesh Kannambadi
pictures.observations: Entire500x750 ordinary shrine detail inspected. Strong star-shaped corners continue through many horizontal base mouldings and receding tower tiers. Lower relief figure niches, upper miniature aedicules/column rhythms, deep projecting eaves, several stacked patterned tower registers and faceted domical top. Original simplified non-narrative figure/animal/leaf vocabulary used; exact deity/story inventory and inscriptions not copied.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Specific Somanathapura Chennakesava standing temple: three stellate stone shrine towers/walls, stepped shared jagati platform, low east-facing mandapa and recessed doorway, original simplified figure/niche/miniature-shrine/frieze vocabulary, patterned receding tower registers and domical caps/finials. Picture-led approximate low enclosing open pillared corridor, east entrance pavilion/short stairs and separate plain stone pillar. Existing shared stone/material graphs; no copied narrative/deity/text atlas, full ritual interior or broad courtyard ground slab.
